paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: Token Ratio (TR).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates token ratios across several models. The horizontal axis displays model labels, including "BT-EVAL," "KoBEST-BQL," “KoBEST-CP," "KoBEST-HS," "KoBEST-SN," and "AVG". Each model label has two associated bars: one in dark blue and one in light blue. A legend indicates that the dark blue bars represent "RedWhale (our)" and the light blue bars represent "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0," "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" and show the token ratio for each. The vertical axis is labeled “TR,” and its scale is linear, ranging from 0 to 1 with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. The shortest dark blue bar, corresponding to the "AVG" model, has a value of approximately 0.42, while the tallest dark blue bar, corresponding to the "BT-EVAL" model, has a value of approximately 0.74. The light blue bars consistently fall between 0.54 and 0.73, for example, the “AVG” light blue bar displaying a value of 0.61, and the "BT-EVAL" light blue bar a value of 0.46. The bars appear to be sorted alphabetically by model label. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their coloring to differentiate the models.
